title: Piercing Statue Trio #020 (쓰리쿼터 · [쓰리쿼터·P8 집중형·빙하 얼음·메이크업 한복화보] ; [쓰리쿼터·P50 정의형·수조·장미 정원·메이크업 히메갸루] ; [쓰리쿼터·P25 집중형·lapis lazuli·메이크업 걸크러시])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, three-quarter statue portrait. THREE women standing side by side, each angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so every woman's whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop. Where a sculpted form comes to an end at the knees, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off. Generous spacing so every figure reads clearly, nobody's arms crossing a neighbour.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Korean woman — fair porcelain skin, two round red yeonji blush circles painted on the cheeks and a small round red gonji dot at the centre of the forehead, clearly defined dark brows, softly lined eyes with bright real catchlights, small vivid red lips, a serene, dignified expression, natural soft black hair styled in twin-tail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge rose-gold clicker ring hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide rose-gold ear cuff, two smaller rose-gold rings and a small rose-gold stud at the top; two rose-gold pieces in a row along the outer end of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a small rose-gold ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small pearls set into the metal.
#1 Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — broad shoulders, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, hips as broad as the shoulders, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#1 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid transparent material, solid glacial ice, with deep cyan where thickest, white streaks of compressed layers and trapped air bubbles, frost in every groove, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, a sweet princess-like smile, soft rose-gold hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick mixed-metal septum ring with a smaller mixed-metal ring above it and two mixed-metal rings through each nostril; a straight mixed-metal bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three mixed-metal pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a mixed-metal Medusa stud above the lips; a big mixed-metal hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a mixed-metal labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small mixed-metal studs along each jaw; a curved row of small mixed-metal studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized mixed-metal hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine mixed-metal chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings.
#2 Physique: A colossal chest, a waist that pulls in sharply beneath it, wide flaring hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#2 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, filled completely to the brim so nothing is hollow and there is no air gap. The glass is unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, with bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights and dark refraction edges where the walls are thickest, tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself. Her shoulders, chest, belly, hips and both thighs keep their exact sculpted shapes as clear glass outlines, and a clean glass rim runs along the boundary where the vessel meets the neck. The vessel holds ONE single world, unbroken and continuous through her whole chest, belly, hips and both thighs, with no split, no second world and no change of contents anywhere: a rose garden at dawn: red and white roses among dark green leaves, a few drifting petals, standing in the clear water that fills her body, denser near the chest and thinning toward the thighs. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and sealed shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh.

#3: A strikingly beautiful adult Korean woman — fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, a cold, commanding gaze, soft rose-gold hair styled in a short pixie cut. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#3 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge silver hoop hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide silver ear cuff, three smaller silver rings, two thick silver bars and a small silver stud up to the top; one small silver stud sits in the right ear; four silver pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small silver rings pass through the left nostril and a thick silver septum ring hangs below the nose; a silver hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a silver snake-bite ring beside it and a small silver ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a silver Medusa stud sits above the lips; a silver labret stud and a small silver ring sit on the chin; three small silver studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small amethysts set into the metal.
#3 Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — broad shoulders, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, hips as broad as the shoulders, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#3 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid opaque stone, solid deep lapis lazuli, a rich royal-blue stone scattered with small glittering flecks of golden pyrite throughout, polished to a hard, cool sheen, completely opaque, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a completely opaque solid that no light passes through; her face, ears and neck are living flesh.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Boundary for each woman: a sharp jagged line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones — real skin above, material immediately below. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow — her skin beside it stays smooth and even. Each rounded tip is that material's own carved finish — never the edge of a photograph. Shards interlock along the collarbone line only.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind them washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep royal blue on one side and a cool silver on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath them.

Pose: each stands tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand relaxed at hip height, every hand well away from every face, heads tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods every transparent body from behind, tinting it, while the opaque bodies block it completely and are lit by two large softboxes raking from either side. A soft frontal light falls on all the faces and ears; a thin cool rim light traces every figure. Only each woman's face, ears and neck read as real skin. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
